promocional: The party game where everyone knows the word… except one. No ads, no subscription, no internet: just one phone and your friends.
descripcion:
Everyone gets the same secret word. Everyone except one: the impostor.

Take turns saying just one word related to it. The impostor doesn't know the word, so they have to listen, bluff and say something that sounds believable. At the end, the group votes on who to accuse. Did you catch them, or did they get away?

ONE PHONE
Type everyone's names in the order you're sitting and pass the phone around. Each player holds a finger on the screen to see their card in secret. No accounts, no internet, and nobody else needs the app.

A HINT THAT GIVES NOTHING AWAY
With hints on, the impostor gets a distant hint that points to the topic but not the word. If the word is Pizza, their hint is Italy, which also works for Lasagna or Spaghetti. They have to listen to everyone else to figure out which one it is. Want more of a challenge? Play with no hints.

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• 3 to 15 players
• 1 or 2 impostors (2 from 6 players; they don't know who the other one is)
• 600+ words in 12 categories: animals, food, fruits and veggies, things at home, school, jobs, sports, transport, places, nature and weather, holidays and traditions, and instruments and music. Playing in the US? You also get a USA category
• Pick the categories you want; words don't repeat until you've played them all
• Big, clear cards that work for kids and grandparents too

NO ADS, EVER
No ads, no subscription and no personal data. The app doesn't collect any information.

Perfect for family gatherings, game nights, road trips and parties.

Made by Daniel Peimbert · @danielpeimbert on X
